title: Membership by an initial walk
statement: Let $K,L,t\in\mathbb{N}$, let $R$ be a relation on natural numbers, and let $\mathrm{Init}$ be a predicate on natural numbers. A natural number $u<K$ satisfies $\mathrm{Init}(u)$ and is related to $t$ by a walk of length at most $L$ using $R$.
